meta.name: discernment-nudge
meta.description: After you give a substantive answer or draft that the user may act on — advice or recommendations, drafted artifacts such as goals, plans, pitches, proposals, or emails, estimates or projections, analysis or interpretation of data, factual claims they may rely on, or a multi-step argument — invoke this skill BEFORE finalizing your reply and then, if it applies, append 2-3 short follow-up questions, each tied to something specific in what you just produced, that help the user check key facts, probe the reasoning or assumptions, and notice missing context. Do this at most once per conversation. Skip it when the user asked a trivial how-to or simple lookup, wants a purely educational explanation, asked you only to format, convert, or assemble a file from content they provided, is writing code they will run, is doing creative writing or casual chat, or already asked you to double-check, cite, or review — the skill file explains these boundaries and the exact output format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追加关键追问,帮你核事实、查假设、补盲区
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手给出的建议不轻信,能被追问关键事实和假设。
copy.tagline_en: Add follow-up questions that probe facts, reasoning, and missing context to your replies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI answers to include critical follow-up questions that verify facts and assumptions.

howto.what: 安装后，当 Claude 给出你可能据此行动的实质性答复（如建议、计划、数据解读等）时，它会在答复末尾追加 2~3 条简短追问，每条针对答复中的某个数字、推理步骤/假设或缺失的背景。每次对话最多一次；若只是简单查询或你已要求核查，则不会出现。
howto.when: 当 Claude 给出的回答包含估算数字、建议或数据解读等可据以行动的内容，而你未要求额外核查时，它会在答复定稿前自动附加追问。同一对话中只触发一次。

say.text: 我刚才那份计划里，哪些假设最该先核实？
say.note: Claude 会针对计划中的假设给出 2~3 条追问。

say.text: 按“值得再看一眼”的格式，给我的数据分析列几条检查问题。
say.note: 会得到针对具体数字和推理的追问列表。

say.text: 这个建议有哪些我没提供的背景可能影响结论？
say.note: Claude 会指出它默默假设的背景。

howto.what_en: When Claude gives a substantive, actionable answer, it appends 2-3 specific follow-up questions about a figure, assumption, or missing context. Once per conversation; skipped for trivial asks or when verification was already requested.
howto.when_en: When Claude's answer includes actable estimates, advice, or data interpretation, and you haven't asked for extra checks, it appends them before finalizing. Once per conversation.

say_en.text: Of the assumptions in that plan I just wrote, which should I verify first?
say_en.note: Claude responds with 2-3 follow-ups about those assumptions.

say_en.text: Give me 2-3 check questions for my data analysis, in the 'second look' style.
say_en.note: Follow-ups tied to specific figures and reasoning.

say_en.text: What background did I not give that could change this recommendation?
say_en.note: Claude points out context it silently assumed.
